Agent Name: Verification_Expert
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: They compiled an incorrect station list for the Franklin–Foxboro Line, mistakenly including Providence/Stoughton and Stoughton branch stops (e.g., Route 128, Canton Junction, Canton Center, Sharon, Mansfield) and omitting actual Franklin Line stops (e.g., Islington, Norwood Depot, Norwood Central). This misplacement led them to position Windsor Gardens incorrectly and overcount the intermediate stops, yielding the wrong total (12).
